items.speaker_state: He is explaining the company's position and offering compensation.

items.reaction_to_previous: He follows the account of Herbert's death with the company's position and offer.
evidence: "Your son died after a machine caught him at work,"

items.speaker_state: Mrs. White is urging her husband to use the paw to bring their son back.
items.scene: A week after the funeral, Mrs. White wakes her husband and calls for Herbert to be brought back.
items.reaction_to_previous: She responds to the news of Herbert's death and the compensation by insisting the paw can bring him back.
evidence: A week after the funeral, Mrs. White woke her husband with tears on her face.
"The company says it isn't to blame, but offers two hundred pounds for your loss."

items.speaker_state: Mr. White is afraid of what might return and reluctant to make the wish.
items.scene: After Mrs. White asks to bring Herbert back, Mr. White answers her.
items.reaction_to_previous: He responds to her demand by explaining his fear and why he hesitates.
evidence: "There are still two wishes in the paw! Bring our son back to life!"
He looked away.

items.speaker_state: Mrs. White insists that their bond with Herbert matters.
items.scene: Mrs. White answers Mr. White's fear as they discuss using the paw.
items.reaction_to_previous: She counters his fear by emphasizing that Herbert is their son.
evidence: "You didn't see him, and I'm afraid of what might return."

items.speaker_state: Mr. White makes the wish, though he is visibly unsteady.
items.scene: Downstairs, with his wife beside him, Mr. White finds the paw and wishes Herbert alive.
items.reaction_to_previous: He gives in after Mrs. White insists that Herbert is their son.
evidence: "But he's our own son!"
his voice was shaking.

items.speaker_state: Mrs. White recognizes Herbert and is eager to reach the door.
items.scene: In the darkness, after a quiet knock, Mrs. White identifies the person at the door.
evidence: A quiet knock broke the silence.
She ran towards the door, pulling free when Mr. White caught her arm.

items.speaker_state: Mr. White urgently asks her to stop before opening the door.
items.scene: As the door shakes with heavy knocks and Mrs. White reaches to open it, Mr. White calls to her.
evidence: The door shook with each heavy knock.
Just as she reached to open the door, he grabbed the paw and made his third and last wish.
